title: Knights of Arc's Inner Circle
summary: The Knights of Arc's Inner Circle are suits of armor that are positioned along the wall of the ring chamber in the Paris Catacombs. The armor each have a set of weapons that they use to protect the Ring of Arc from any intruders and will glow with magical energy when activated. Using any other magic only makes the weapons stronger, so the trap must be defeated by demolishing their suits of armor, the source of the enchantment.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[Joan of Arc]] set this trap to guard the [[Ring of Arc]] within the [[Paris Catacombs]] as the ring was a powerful artifact and the source of her visions. When the ring chamber was entered by [[Dante Vale]], [[Zhalia Moon]], [[Lok Lambert]], and [[Sophie Casterwill]], the trap was activated and began to attack them. The Knights of Arc's Inner Circle were only defeated when their suits of armor were dismantled. {{source|Crawling the Catacombs}}
